assets.name: courtyard-v3
assets.prompt: Original fantasy adventure game art inspired by the restrained hand-painted natural environments of Zelda Breath of the Wild / Tears of the Kingdom, without copying characters, emblems, lettering or specific architecture. Cel-painted broad color planes, matte materials, subtle edges, one clear upper-left daylight direction, restrained soft shadows. No photorealism, no glossy jewelry, no chrome, no gold, no ornate filigree, no neon, no particles, no stars, no text, no logos, no UI. Wide 16:9 playable environment background plate. Quiet sunlit ancient limestone courtyard on a high grassy plateau. Eye-level camera slightly looking down over a broad continuous walkable pale stone ground in the lower 45 percent of frame, its perspective leads to horizon at 55 percent height. A low broken wall and ONE asymmetrical eroded pillar at far left edge; a slim wind-shaped tree at far right edge. Muted sage grass along courtyard edges, distant layered blue-green hills and open pale hazy blue sky. Center 65 percent of image is spacious and empty for interactive objects to be overlaid. Upper left 25 percent and right 25 percent mostly clear quiet surfaces for text. No central monument, no floating islands, no castles, no ornamental circular floor pattern, no symmetrical arches. Deliberate simple composition, large readable silhouettes, hand-painted gouache character, controlled detail only at edges.

assets.name: relic-core-v3
assets.prompt: Original fantasy adventure game art inspired by the restrained hand-painted natural environments of Zelda Breath of the Wild / Tears of the Kingdom, without copying characters, emblems, lettering or specific architecture. Cel-painted broad color planes, matte materials, subtle edges, one clear upper-left daylight direction, restrained soft shadows. No photorealism, no glossy jewelry, no chrome, no gold, no ornate filigree, no neon, no particles, no stars, no text, no logos, no UI. Single isolated interactive central artifact sprite on genuine transparent background, full object visible with generous margin, portrait 4:5 composition. A weathered warm chalk limestone U-shaped cradle made of two chunky unequal ancient stone uprights on a short heavy square plinth, partially broken at one side. Between uprights floats a single small opaque muted jade-green irregular six-sided mineral, about one quarter the artifact's total height. Mineral has just four or five large flat color planes, chalky ceramic stone surface, no glass reflections. A thin softly luminous pale green seam in its middle, very subtle. No rings, no spherical ball, no gem-cuts, no crystals cluster, no runes, no decorative engravings, no grass, no environment. Friendly rough-hewn silhouette, slight 3/4 camera view from above, light upper left, cast only minimal contact shadow on plinth itself. Object center empty enough to recognize green mineral; stone is main material.
